Package expressions

Class Operation

java.lang.Object
expressions.Expression
expressions.Operation
Direct Known Subclasses:
Addition, Division, Multiplication, Subtraction
public abstract class Operation extends Expression
Abstract base for binary operations: addition, subtraction, multiplication and division.

Holds the two operands and the operator symbol. Provides shared printing, equality, hashing and simplification entry point.

    • simplify

      public Expression simplify()
      Returns a simplified version of this expression. The original expression is not modified. Simplifies both operands first, then applies the operation's own simplification rule via simplifyOp(expressions.Expression, expressions.Expression).
      Specified by:
      simplify in class Expression
      Returns:
      a new simplified expression

      public void print(PrintStream out)
      Prints this expression to the given stream. Every operation is wrapped in parentheses, no spaces. Prints operands separated by the operator, wrapped in parentheses.

    • equals

      public boolean equals(Object o)
      Compares this expression with another for structural equality. Two expressions are equal if they have the same structure and the same leaf values; commutativity is not considered. Two operations are equal if they are of the same class and both operands are structurally equal.
      Specified by:
      equals in class Expression
      Parameters:
      o - the object to compare with
      Returns:
      true if the expressions are structurally equal
